name: Ray Peat's Carrot Salad
author: rami-shafikov on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 3 raw carrots, peeled in thick vertical strips and washed thoroughly

steps: Grate the carrot and rinse out under water. Then mix with coconut oil and vinegar, I also like to add a pinch or two of salt.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
